blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator-judges must personally engage with the evidence in an impeachment trial before exercising the power to decide an official’s fate, retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban told the Senate impeachment court Wednesday. Panganiban said the constitutional duty of senator-judges requires more than simply being counted as members of the chamber, stressing that “active participation […]...
